name: Untere Roßgumpenalp
kurzbeschreibung: **Discover the Untere Roßgumpenalp in Tirol** Nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps, the **Untere Roßgumpenalp** is a hidden gem for nature lovers and adventure seekers alike. This charming alpine hut offers breathtaking views, fresh mountain air, and an authentic taste of Tyrolean hospitality. **Hiking & Exploration** Start your adventure with a scenic hike through lush meadows and dense forests, leading to panoramic vistas of the surrounding peaks. The well-marked trails cater to all levels, from leisurely strolls to challenging climbs. **Traditional Tyrolean Cuisine** Indulge in hearty alpine dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, and **Schlutzkrapfen**, all prepared with locally sourced ingredients. Pair your meal with a glass of crisp **Tiroler Apfelwein** or a warm **Glühwein** for the perfect alpine experience. **Relaxation & Wellness** Unwind in the cozy common room with a book or enjoy a game of cards by the crackling fireplace. For those seeking tranquility, the peaceful surroundings make it an ideal retreat. **Accommodation** The **Untere Roßgumpenalp** provides simple yet comfortable lodging, perfect for hikers, families, and groups. Whether you're looking for a short getaway or an extended stay, this alpine refuge promises unforgettable memories. **Location & Access** Reachable by foot or via a short drive from nearby villages, the **Untere Roßgumpenalp** is easily accessible from **Innsbruck**, **Imst**, or **Landeck**. The exact route can be provided upon request. **Events & Activities** Throughout the season, the hut hosts guided hikes, storytelling evenings, and traditional music sessions, adding to the authentic alpine experience. **Visit Us** Escape the hustle and bustle and immerse yourself in the serene beauty of the **Tirol** Alps at the **Untere Roßgumpenalp**. Whether you're here for adventure, relaxation, or culinary delights, this alpine haven has something for everyone. **More Information** **Contact Us**
